[Intro]
[C]

[Verse 1]
[C]What's the matter with the
[Em]clothes I'm wearing? Can't you
[Bb]tell that your tie's too wide?
[F]
[C]Maybe I should buy some
[Em]old tab collars? Welcome
[Bb]back to the age of jive
[F]

[Pre-Chorus]
[Em]Where have you been hidin'
[Am]out lately, honey? You
[Em]can't dress trashy till you
[D]spend a lot of [G]money

[Chorus]
[C]Everybody's [Em]talkin' 'bout the
[Bb]new sound [F]Funny, but it's
[Am]still rock and [G]roll to me
[C]

[Verse 2]
[C]What's the matter with the
[Em]car I'm driving? Can't you
[Bb]tell that it's out of style?
[F]
[C]Should I get a set of
[Em]white wall tires? Are you
[Bb]gonna cruise the miracle mile?
[F]

[Pre-Chorus]
[Em]Nowadays you can't be
[Am]too sentimental Your
[Em]best bet's a true baby
[D]blue [G]Continental

[Chorus]
[C]Hot funk, [Em]cool punk,
[Bb]even if it's [F]old junk It's
[Am]still rock and [G]roll to me
[C]
Oh,

[Bridge]
[G]it doesn't matter what they
[F]say in the papers Cause it's
[E]always been the same old scene
[Am]There's a
[G]new band in town But you
[F]can't get the sound from a
[E]story in a magazine...
[G#]Ai-
[Eb]med at your average teen
[F]
[G]

[Verse 3]
[C]How about a pair of
[Em]pink sidewinders And a
[Bb]bright orange pair of pants?
[F]
[C]You could really be a
[Em]Beau Brummel baby If you
[Bb]just give it half a chance
[F]

[Pre-Chorus]
[Em]Don't waste your money on a
[Am]new set of speakers You
[Em]get more mileage from a
[D]cheap pair of [G]sneakers

[Chorus]
[C]Next phase, [Em]new wave,
[Bb]dance craze, [F]anyways It's
[Am]still rock and [G]roll to me
[C]

[Solo]
[G]
[F]

[G]
[F]

[F]
[C]Should I try to be a
[Em]straight 'A' student? If you
[Bb]are then you think too much
[F]

[Pre-Chorus]
[Em]Don't you know about the
[Am]new fashion honey?
[Em]All you need are looks and a
[D]whole lotta [G]money It's

[C7]
